capabilities.label: Clinical service delivery
capabilities.notes: Medical care is delivered through NC Medicaid Managed Care health plans and providers, not by DHHS staff
capabilities.to_resolve: Amend or add a managed-care or provider contract (division-level decision)

capabilities.label: Behavioral health service delivery
capabilities.notes: LME/MCOs manage mental health, I/DD and substance use services under DHHS contracts; DHHS also runs state psychiatric hospitals directly
capabilities.to_resolve: Route through LME/MCO contract amendment

capabilities.label: Long-term care facility operation
capabilities.notes: Division of State Operated Healthcare Facilities runs developmental centers and Neuro-Medical Treatment Centers (CMS-certified skilled nursing)

capabilities.label: Public health surveillance
capabilities.notes: Division of Public Health runs statewide surveillance, including NC DETECT behavioral health syndromic surveillance (DHHS Strategic Plan 2023-25, strategy G3.5.2, PDF p.15)

capabilities.label: Data systems and interoperability
capabilities.notes: DHHS invests in enterprise data collection, integration and storage for staff and partners (DHHS Strategic Plan 2023-25, strategy G5.1.3, PDF p.19)

capabilities.label: Research and rigorous evaluation
capabilities.notes: Independent evaluation is contracted to university partners, e.g. UNC Sheps Center evaluates the Medicaid 1115 waiver and Healthy Opportunities Pilots
capabilities.to_resolve: Letter of commitment or subcontract with a university evaluator

capabilities.label: Housing stock or assistance
capabilities.notes: DHHS does not control housing stock; affordable units are reached through the NC Housing Finance Agency Targeting Program partnership
capabilities.to_resolve: MOU or letter of support from NC Housing Finance Agency or a housing authority

capabilities.label: Transportation services
capabilities.notes: Non-emergency medical transportation is provided by Medicaid health plans through transportation brokers, and by county DSS for Medicaid Direct
capabilities.to_resolve: Add scope to health-plan or broker contract

capabilities.label: Workforce training and credentialing
capabilities.notes: Caregiving and early childhood workforce pipelines are built 'in collaboration with partners' (DHHS Strategic Plan 2023-25, Goal 4, PDF p.17); training delivery sits with community colleges and AHEC
capabilities.to_resolve: Partnership agreement with community colleges or AHEC

capabilities.label: Emergency management
capabilities.notes: NC Emergency Management is a division of the Department of Public Safety and coordinates all state agencies in emergencies
capabilities.to_resolve: Coordination agreement with NC Emergency Management (DPS)

capabilities.label: Benefits eligibility administration
capabilities.notes: NC social services are state-supervised and county-administered: 100 county DSS agencies deliver benefits; DHHS supervises
capabilities.to_resolve: County DSS participation agreements

capabilities.label: Capital construction
capabilities.notes: Building projects are delivered with the NC Department of Administration (New NCDHHS Campus; DHHS Strategic Plan 2023-25, strategy G5.3.1, PDF p.20) and the State Construction Office
capabilities.to_resolve: Capital appropriation and State Construction Office project

capabilities.label: Laboratory services
capabilities.notes: State Laboratory of Public Health provides medical and environmental testing

capabilities.label: Subrecipient network management
capabilities.notes: DHHS manages contracts and reporting for LME/MCOs and supervises 100 county agencies

capabilities.label: Clinical service delivery
capabilities.notes: DMVA program list includes benefits advocacy, veterans homes, cemeteries, scholarships and transition services; no clinical services
capabilities.to_resolve: Partner with DHHS or the federal VA health system

capabilities.label: Behavioral health service delivery
capabilities.notes: No behavioral health programs in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Partner with DHHS behavioral health or the federal VA

capabilities.label: Long-term care facility operation
capabilities.notes: State Veterans Homes are managed day to day by a private contractor (PruittHealth) under a state contract administered by DMVA; DMVA lists 5 homes
capabilities.to_resolve: Amend the veterans homes management contract

capabilities.label: Public health surveillance
capabilities.notes: Not in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Partner with DHHS Division of Public Health

capabilities.label: Data systems and interoperability
capabilities.notes: DMVA's own plan asks how retention data can be tracked across multiple agency systems (G1.O2 Priority Question, p.5)
capabilities.to_resolve: Data-sharing agreement with partner agencies

capabilities.label: Research and rigorous evaluation
capabilities.notes: Not in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Contract a university evaluator

capabilities.label: Housing stock or assistance
capabilities.notes: DMVA connects veterans to resources but does not provide housing; housing reached through community partners
capabilities.to_resolve: MOU with housing providers or NC Housing Finance Agency

capabilities.label: Transportation services
capabilities.notes: Not in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Partner with DOT or local transit

capabilities.label: Workforce training and credentialing
capabilities.notes: Talent pipeline built by partnering with state agencies, veteran employment programs and NC higher education (DMVA Strategic Plan 2025-29, G4.O2, PDF p.11)
capabilities.to_resolve: Partnership with NCWorks or community colleges

capabilities.label: Emergency management
capabilities.notes: Not in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Coordinate with NC Emergency Management (DPS)

capabilities.label: Benefits eligibility administration
capabilities.notes: 12 Veterans Service Centers with accredited Veterans Service Officers prepare, submit and track benefit claims

capabilities.label: Capital construction
capabilities.notes: Veterans homes modernization runs through the State Construction Office Facilities Condition Assessment Program (DMVA Strategic Plan 2025-29, G2.O1, PDF p.7)
capabilities.to_resolve: Capital appropriation and State Construction Office project

capabilities.label: Laboratory services
capabilities.notes: Not in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Contract a laboratory

capabilities.label: Subrecipient network management
capabilities.notes: No subgrant programs in DMVA's program list
capabilities.to_resolve: Build subaward administration capacity (new staff)
